conversion_stepper.create_api_key_hint: You'll need a secret API key to authenticate server-side API calls.
conversion_stepper.nodejs_prerequisites: This is server-side tracking — no client-side script is required on your site. You only need to read the click ID from the browser cookie or query parameter.
conversion_stepper.nodejs_cookie_title: How to get the click ID
conversion_stepper.nodejs_cookie_desc: When a user clicks your short link, Li2 appends ?uid=… to the destination URL. If you have the client-side SDK installed it stores this automatically in the li_cid cookie. On your server, read it from req.cookies['li_cid'] (Node.js) or $_COOKIE['li_cid'] (PHP). If no client SDK is installed, read the ?uid= query parameter directly and pass it as click_id.
